ios.desc:
Prime Video is your all-in-one destination for hit movies, series and TV, live sports, and more. Stream the hit sci-fi adventure Project Hail Mary and the epic fantasy Masters of the Universe, now streaming on Prime Video. From gripping originals like Reacher, Every Year After, Spider Noir, and Off Campus to blockbuster films and live entertainment, there's always something worth watching. Personalized recommendations help you find your next favorite show or movie without the scroll.

Prime Video brings the best of TV and film together with your favorite live sports. Your Prime membership includes Thursday Night Football, select WNBA & NBA games, and more. Watch even more of the movies, TV, and live sports you love when you choose from 100+ subscriptions like Starz and Apple TV+ — all in one app.

Download videos for offline viewing, cast to your TV, and create profiles so everyone in the house gets a personalized entertainment experience.
One app. Endless entertainment. Watch your favorite movies, TV, and live sports—all on Prime Video.

TV and Series
•	Edge-of-your-seat originals like Reacher, The Boys, Fallout, and Spider-Noir streaming on Prime Video
•	Addictive series including Off Campus, Every Year After, and The Summer I Turned Pretty
•	Epic worlds brought to life on your TV with The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power and more
•	Go behind the scenes with exclusive X-Ray access, powered by IMDb

Movies
•	Stream new hit releases like Project Hail Mary and Masters of the Universe, now on Prime Video
•	Watch hit Prime Video originals such as Tom Clancy’s Jack Ryan: Ghost War, Your Fault: London and more
•	Rent or buy newly released films the same day they hit digital
•	Download videos and watch your favorite movies offline, anywhere, anytime

Sports
•	Watch live NFL games with Thursday Night Football
•	Watch select NBA and WNBA games

Enjoy Prime Video updates on your Apple TV or Mac by downloading the latest app from the App Store on your device. 

If you subscribe to Prime Video, payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, and your membership automatically renews monthly unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the then current plan period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of each plan period at the rate of your selected plan. Manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal anytime by going to My Account.

quotes.text:
Google does not take a 30% cut of all content sold through apps on Google Play. On Android, the in-app purchase rule only applies to content that can only be consumed via apps (so not Netflix, Amazon, etc.).

And even on iOS, Amazon still has video apps, they just don't allow you to buy or rent directly within the app:  
https://itunes.apple.com/app/amazon-video/id545519333

There's nothing stopping Amazon from supporting Apple TV or Chromecast, except itself.
quotes.story_title: Amazon Will Ban Sale of Apple, Google Video-Streaming Devices
